import cmath
z = 1 + 1j
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.sin(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.cos(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.tan(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.asin(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.acos(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.atan(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.sinh(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.cosh(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.tanh(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.asinh(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.acosh(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.atanh(z))[0], 6))
